notes.title: Loafing Town PlayTest Q&A
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595956/d6e854d9fe0b2bf0f69527a651caa23f31dd5e0b.png[/img]

[h1][b]Some Answers to Common Questions About the Loafing Town PlayTest:[/b][/h1]

[b]1. Does the game support cloud saves?[/b]  
A: Due to the rushed release of the PlayTest, we didn’t plan everything thoroughly. Currently, cloud saves are not supported in the PlayTest, and there will be no further updates to this version. However, cloud save functionality will be available in the upcoming demo and full release.  
If you want to transfer your save to another computer, please copy it from the following path and place it in the same location on the other machine:  
C:\Users\Admin\AppData\LocalLow\GoblinZ\LoafingTown\saves

[b]2. Will save files carry over to future versions?[/b]  
A: Unfortunately, the PlayTest version was from an early stage of development, and the future versions will be significantly different—so saves will not be compatible.

[b]3. When will the game be updated or officially released?[/b]  
A: The release is tentatively planned for Q4, but this might change.

[b]4. Where can I find guides or tips?[/b]  
A: Chinese players can join the QQ group and ask experienced players: 585750932  
If you’re already a pro, we encourage you to share guides on X or Youtube!

[b]5. Is the developer handsome?[/b]  
A: Undeniably handsome.

notes.title: 20250430 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you all so much for your love and testing of my game. 
[/b]If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please fill out the [b]survey[/b]! 
This update mainly addresses some tricky issues. Since I’m a solo developer, my time is very limited. From now on, unless there are critical bugs, there will be no more new content updates for the PlayTest version of Loafing Town. I’ll be focusing on the development of future versions. 
Upcoming tests will be small-scale, and I’ll announce the times on my X account [b]@Tenffy_Z[/b] (outside Mainland China) and [b]QQ group: 585750932[/b] (Mainland China). Finally, heartfelt thanks to everyone who helped test Loafing Town before the public release.

[b]Additions:
[/b][list]
[*] Added toggle for altar reminders
[*] Added survey button
[*] Added anti-mistouch bar at hero height to prevent desktop clicks
[*] Chaos level cap increased to 80
[/list]
[b]Fixes:
[/b][list]
[*] Fixed issue where heroes wouldn't age after long AFK time
[*] Fixed gold display overflow issue at the altar
[*] Fixed cost display overflow issue for monster summoning
[*] Fixed issue where monsters wouldn't respawn after final stage
[*] Fixed issue where boss could reduce hero HP to negative
[/list]
[b]Adjustments:
[/b][list]
[*] Removed the delete save button (Don't click it before updating!)
[*] Expanded debug window area and made small block controls smaller
[/list]
